decisions.reason: Grounded in the console capture (entry 200 at 8.1 kB, sibling 404s, siblings not shipped): explains that sibling imports resolve relative to the fetched chunk URL and one failed static child rejects the whole dynamic import despite the entry loading; prescribes a self-contained single-file chunk with code splitting disabled (inlineDynamicImports/splitting:false/manualChunks) or shipping the complete dependency set.

Uses the ci-note debug values against the route code: LIB_DIR keeps uppercase E: from fileURLToPath while realpathSync on win32 returns lowercase e:, so the ordinal case-sensitive startsWith rejects an actually contained file; explains Linux (single canonical POSIX form) and the laptop (coincidentally matching case) pass. Does not claim all Windows paths are unreliable or universal lowercasing beyond the win32 realpath behavior.

Proposes realpath of both base and target followed by path.relative containment (rejecting empty-parent, '..' traversal, and absolute results) with win32-only case folding, handles junction/symlink escapes via double realpath, and keeps a JavaScript MIME type plus stable same-origin URL for the dynamic import to work.

Explains both the pane font handler and modal zoom handler act on one bubbling Ctrl+wheel, gives the modal exclusive ownership via preventDefault plus stopPropagation while the pane handler stands down (scoping to the pane element, ignoring events inside the modal, dropping window/capture shortcuts), and notes late stopPropagation cannot undo ancestor capture.

Full matrix with expected outcomes: build-time chunk-closure/self-containment check plus import smoke (no code-block fallback); containment unit test where the case-differing contained Windows path serves 200 while traversal, sibling-prefix, non-js and symlink escapes are refused, with JavaScript content-type contract; and a DOM test asserting modal Ctrl+wheel zooms the diagram without changing pane font size (and the inverse with modal closed).

caps.reason: The recommended fix strengthens containment (canonicalized path.relative check rejecting traversal, absolute results and symlink escapes); it never disables the guard or serves paths outside the plugin lib root.
